resources.string: Choose a hotspot interface in Connection setup before connecting.
The saved interface is not available. Turn on the car hotspot and select an interface again.
No usable network interface was found. Turn on the car hotspot and reopen this list.
Turn on the car hotspot, choose its network interface and save. Only interfaces currently available on this head unit are listed. Your choice is remembered for the next connection.

Start with Auto. If the phone recognizes the car but no picture appears, try IPv4 compatibility and select the interface whose IPv4 address matches the router shown in your iPhone’s Wi-Fi details. Turn the car hotspot on before opening the interface list. Changes apply to the next connection.
